描述_EN: the craftsman, keen to show off his skill, added a third dragon above the rim. the two handles of this cup are in the form of dragons. this makes the cup more of a decorative piece than a vessel with a practical function.
描述_ZN: 工匠热衷于炫耀自己的技艺，在杯口上方添加了第三条龙。 这个杯子的两个把手是龙的形状。 这使得这个杯子更像是一个装饰品，而不是一个具有实用功能的容器。
